# Sam Osborne

> Sam Osborne is a keynote speaker on staying calm under pressure and a trained Demartini Method Facilitator, based in Los Angeles (Burbank, California). He helps sales teams, attorneys, financial advisors, executives and fraud investigators stay calm when a buyer, client, opposing counsel or interview subject gets under their skin. He speaks at sales kickoffs (SKOs), law firm retreats and wellness CLE programs, advisor conferences, and investigator training conferences, and every program includes a live on-stage demonstration with a volunteer. He gives keynotes and workshops and works privately by video with accomplished professionals in 10 countries. His work is educational facilitation, not therapy.

## Private sessions
- [Private Demartini Method Sessions](https://samosborne.net/calm): One-to-one sessions by video for professionals held back by impostor syndrome, self-doubt, guilt, or one person they can't stop reacting to. Breakthrough Session $1,100; Six-Session Program $4,500. Starts with a free 20-minute fit call.
- [Leadership Advisory](https://samosborne.net/leadership-advisory): Private facilitation for leaders in high-stakes roles.

## Speaking
- [Keynotes: The Conflict Advantage](https://samosborne.net/): Keynotes on staying calm under pressure, handling tough buyers and difficult clients, and not taking things personally. Good fit for a sales kickoff where reps cave on price, a law firm retreat on burnout, an advisor conference on handling emotional clients, or investigator training on staying objective in interviews. Includes a live on-stage demonstration with a volunteer. 95% of attendees rated his delivery excellent across 39 evaluations at the 2026 CAI National Law Seminar.
- [Program formats](https://samosborne.net/programs): Keynote, breakout, half-day workshop, and multi-session formats for meeting planners.
- [Composure Through Conflict](https://samosborne.net/composure): Program co-presented with David Graf.
